model_output.rationale: All four lines carry OA-18 (exact duplicate). CLP07 confirms adjudication. Chart note documents two 97140 segments (15 + 14 min = 2 units) and two 97110 segments (31 + 16 min = 3 units) billed as four separate lines. Lines 3 and 4 share the same CPT/modifier/DOS as lines 1–2, triggering duplicate edits. This is a false duplicate: correct billing consolidates to 97140 × 2 units and 97110 × 3 units on one line each. Medicare Part B does not accept CLM05-3=7; remedy is a new original claim.

root_cause.explanation: Split billing of same-CPT timed units across two lines each (97140 ×1+1; 97110 ×2+1) caused lines 3–4 to collide with lines 1–2 on the duplicate edit. Services are legitimate; billing is incorrect.

next_action.detail: Submit a new original claim (CLM05-3=1, no REF*F8) consolidating to: 97140-GP-KX 2 units; 97110-GP-KX 3 units. Medicare Part B rejects frequency 7. Act promptly — DOS 2026-07-05, 1-year filing limit is 2027-07-05.

evidence.fact: All four lines denied OA-18; CLP07=2623576767957 confirms adjudication; MOA N111.
